preconditions.description: The input verb must be a string.
The input verb must end with one of the infinitive suffixes 'ar', 'er', or 'ir'.

postconditions.description: The result must be a dictionary with the original verb as the key.
The value of the verb key must be a list of exactly six conjugated forms.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(form, str) for form in result[verb])
postconditions.description: All conjugated forms must be strings.
